about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Lori Trahan

pages.title: Congresswoman Lori Trahan | Proudly representing Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District
pages.text:
Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
Congresswoman Lori Trahan | Proudly representing Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District
Congresswoman Lori Trahan introduced the Pandemic Production Act
'It ensures we never get caught flat-footed by a pandemic or an infectious disease outbreak again.'
The Merrimack River: A treasure worth protecting – By Lori Trahan
'Grant funding is absolutely vital when the scale of wastewater infrastructure projects is so large.'
Congresswoman Trahan, accompanied by other state officials, visited farms in Littleton, Stow and Fitchburg.
